description: Sequencer played by dragging the mouse over a 32 by 32 pad, recording what is played into one of 100 patterns and playing it back on a clock

params.text: Plays the current pattern back from its start, with the gate high until it ends
Picks which of the four scales the pad is quantised to
Picks which of the four clock inputs drives the module
Shifts the whole output up or down in octaves, -4 to 4
Shifts the whole output up in semitones, 0 to 11
Takes the note, velocity and gate from the X, Y and Gate inputs in place of the mouse, so another module can play and record into the pad
Picks which of the 100 patterns is recorded into and played back
While on, the pattern is picked by hand and a cable in the pattern input no longer moves the selection

inputs.text: One of the four clock inputs; only the selected one is read, and every step of playing and recording happens on its rising edge
Sets the semitone shift, 1.2 semitones per volt
Sets the octave shift, one octave per volt
Sets the column, and so the velocity, while Mode is on, 0-10V across the 32 columns
Sets the row, and so the note, while Mode is on, 0-10V across the 32 rows
Starts and stops a note while Mode is on: above 5V is a note held, below is silence, and the recording of a pattern runs while it is high
A rising edge plays the current pattern back from its start
Selects the scale, 2.5V per scale, and overrides the scale selector while patched
Selects the clock input, 2.5V per input, and overrides the clock selector while patched
Selects the pattern, 0.1V per pattern over 0-10V; while it is patched the pattern cannot be picked by hand unless Lock is on

outputs.text: The note under the play position as a pitch, quantised to the selected scale and shifted by the Octave and Semitone controls
The column of the play position as a voltage, 0-10V across the pad, which is the velocity of the note
Carries 10V while a note is held and while a pattern is playing back
A 10ms trigger each time the note changes

notes: pressing and dragging on the pad plays and records, and clicking a note in one of the four scale strips takes it out of that scale or puts it back
while the pointer is over the pad the keys z, x, c and v pick the clock input and a, s, d and f pick the scale

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.8: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.9: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
